title: Naya Create hardware parts list, read from the FCC filings
license: CC BY 4.0 (Create-knowledge-base); the underlying facts come from public FCC records
scope: Naya Create halves, Speedlink dongle, Naya Tune, Touch, Track, accessories; FCC IDs 2BQ4V0825CRL, 2BQ4V0825CRR, 2BQ4V0825DG
notes: Every photographed unit is a pre-production sample received by the lab on 2025-06-20; no firmware version is printed in the filings; retail boards may differ.
Serial-number fields, QR and 2D codes, lab sample tags and handwriting visible in the exhibits are not reproduced here; blur or crop them in any reused image.
Grant dates and grant lines come from the FCC EAS record for grantee 2BQ4V (read 2026-09-23); ISED numbers from the ISED Radio Equipment List, company 34320.

Rows measured on hardware read "measured on one <unit>, <firmware>, <date>". Rejected readings are published only where they appeared in another public source (naya-create-kb); readings from our own earlier working notes are omitted.
Module and cable photos are the same image files in both halves' filings (left page N = right page N-3 for modules, N-1 for cables): a CRL/CRR pair of citations is one photograph of one sample.
